messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning to push an offline installer bundle epoch to private-vpc staging today. Need final sign-off on shrinkwrap, release notes edits, and an emergency unpin/rollback plan. cc @jon @satoshi

jon: Ack. What are the exact artifacts and manifest names we're shipping?

maria: Manifest: shrinkwrap-20260320-epoch.json. Images: rwdw/infra:2026.3.20, rwdw/installer@sha256:abcd1234ef56.... Signer: staging-key-2 (cosign).

satoshi: Quick question — if something goes wrong, can we avoid a full rebuild? want a clear emergency unpin flow.

tess: Also FYI KMS rotation window is scheduled at 15:30 UTC. We should avoid starting right into that.

maria: Good catch. Proposed timeline: start publish at 14:30 UTC, 30m canary, full rollout at 15:00. That gives a buffer before KMS rotation at 15:30.

jon: For emergency unpin I see two realistic options:
1) Immediate mitigation: point manifests at the previous epoch and run deploy-bot rollback (fast).
2) Rebuild + re-sign small patch and re-publish (slower, but fixes root cause).
We should document both; default emergency action = option 1.

satoshi: Agreed. Deploy-bot rollback command example (ops-runbook):
```bash
/deploy rollback --manifest=shrinkwrap-20260313-epoch.json --env=staging --reason="hotfix-unavailable"
```

maria: Ops note: must notify customer liaison before initiating rollback. Release notes PR: rwd/release-notes#482 (I updated draft).

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy accepted: schedule 2026-03-20T14:30:00Z by maria. Canary window: 30m. Hooks: signer-check, checksum-verify, manifest-publish.

jon: I'll add a preflight step: `scripts/verify-bundle.sh shrinkwrap-20260320-epoch.json` — will post results here.

tess: I'll update release-notes to include a Known Issues section re: initial installer telemetry bug and note that customers should expect a short canary window.

maria: Rollback criteria (documenting here so it's explicit):
- >10% failed installs in canary OR
- average agent start latency >120s OR
- cosign signature mismatch on any node
If any trigger, call rollback and pin previous manifest.

satoshi: Escort/transport checklist: ensure checksum mirrors present (mirror-edge-1, mirror-edge-2), cosign signature available, and signer key not rotated. If we need to re-sign, use staging-signer only.

jon: Permission model: only @maria @jon @satoshi may trigger deploy-bot rollback for private-vpc/staging. I'll add a short runbook snippet in docs repo (rwd/docs#deploy-runbook).

maria: I'll open that runbook PR after this thread and attach the exact rollback commands. Anyone object to 14:30 start?

tess: :thumbsup:

jon: :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled and will post status updates in this thread at start/completion. run_id=deploy-20260320-1415-1

maria: Uploading bundle to mirror-edge-2 now, will post checksum when done.

maria: checksum: sha256:ef12c9d4a77b4e3f9c0b9a4f6d7a8e90789abcef1234567890abcdef12345678

satoshi: Got the checksum, will verify after publish.

jon: preflight passed locally, posting green: ✅ preflight shrinkwrap-20260320 OK

maria: Quick checklist recap: release-note PR linked, runbook + rollback commands in progress, KMS rotation window accounted for, canary window set to 30m, mirrors prepared. Ready to start at 14:30 UTC unless I hear objections.

maria: One more ops detail: if we do immediate unpin, the steps are:
1) update live-manifest pointer in S3 to previous manifest
2) run `/deploy rollback --manifest=<previous>`
3) notify customer liaison + update release-notes with rollback entry
4) open hotfix ticket to rebuild the next epoch
Please follow exactly — we want an auditable trail.

satoshi: Copy. I'll be on-call during the window and will verify cosign signatures post-publish.

jon: I'll watch the deploy-bot logs and monitor install success metrics.

maria: Thanks all — will start the publish and post updates.
